thread:
Maya (csops): heads up — we spotted metric sparsity in the onboarding funnel this morning. a bunch of accounts never emitted `first_successful_session` so the onboarding playbook never triggered for them. digging in now but want to coordinate a cleanroom backfill + enablement handoff.

Ethan (dataops): ugh. is this the same null->legacy-import issue from last quarter? can you paste a quick sample query of the bad rows?

Maya (csops): looks related but different shape — some rows have timestamps but the `session_type` field is empty. sample: ```sql
SELECT account_id, created_at, session_type FROM onboarding_events
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15'
AND session_type IS NULL
LIMIT 10;
```

Ethan (dataops): ok that helps. i'll run a full-timebox and get counts by cohort. rough plan: 1) run dedupe + infer session_type where we can (heuristics), 2) flag remaining accounts for playbook dry-run, 3) schedule playbook dry-run. i'll post results in ~45m.

Riley (enablement): +1 to dry-run before any outbound. if the playbook missed onboarding triggers, we should prioritize high-ARR and trial->paid cohorts. i can own outreach for top 200 once you give the list. also need a short script for templated nudges.

Maya (csops): perfect. priority tiers: tier A = ARR > $50k, tier B = trial started in last 30 days, tier C = newly-imported accounts. will include a field `backfill_reason` in the output so enablement can customize messaging.

Ethan (dataops): results ready — counts attached (summary): tier A: 34, tier B: 412, tier C: 1,203. heuristic infer fixed ~60% of nulls. remaining ~800 accounts need manual trigger. uploading CSV to #cs-ops-bucket: gs://redwood-cs/backfill/1715501234-backfill.csv

Playbook Bot: scheduled run created by @Maya (csops) — playbook "onboard-v2-backfill" will run in DRY-RUN mode at 2026-03-22T16:30Z. logs will be written to /playbooks/backfill/1715501234/dryrun.log

Riley (enablement): thanks — i'll take top 200 (prioritize tier A then high-usage tier B). can you include columns: account_owner, last_seen, recommended_message_template_id? also, can we toggle the dry-run to actually open tasks instead of sending emails? i prefer tasks first.

Maya (csops): yep adding those columns now. dry-run -> task mode is an option in the playbook config, i can flip it once we confirm samples. sample config snippet: ```yaml
playbook: onboard-v2-backfill
mode: dry_run # options: dry_run, task_open, send_email
filters:
  - cohort: inferred_backfill
  - min_arr: 0
routing:
  - owner: account_owner
  - priority: cohort_tier
```

Ethan (dataops): exported a 500-row sample to Slack DM to @Riley. quick sanity checks: 1) verify account_owner is up-to-date, 2) confirm `last_seen` is not older than 90 days for outreach window.

Riley (enablement): got it. will run through samples and flag any owners we should reassign. timeline: review samples today, start owner task creation tomorrow morning.

Maya (csops): after owner tasks are created, we'll bake in a 7-day hold to let owners do tailored outreach, then escalate to templated nudges for anything still uncontacted. will document the runbook in Confluence under CS Ops > Backfills.

Ethan (dataops): small note — the heuristic infers session_type from event_path and user_agent. put that into the CSV as `inference_confidence`. threshold i used: >0.75 to auto-apply.

Riley (enablement): nice. if `inference_confidence` < 0.75, prefer task for owner to validate. good to avoid false positives.

Maya (csops): wrapping up — next steps: Ethan to push full CSV to bucket (done), Maya to toggle playbook to task_open for tier A sample (in 30m), Riley to review samples and confirm owners. will post final rollout plan in this thread. thanks all :heart: 

Ethan (dataops): +1, monitoring the backfill job. will ping if any errors.

Playbook Bot: playbook run completed (dry-run) — 500 simulated triggers, 0 send_email actions performed, 46 tasks suggested for owner review. report: gs://redwood-cs/backfill/1715501234/dryrun_report.json

Riley (enablement): seeing the report now. will start owner task creation for the 46 suggested. ping me if you want me to split outreach templates by tier.

Maya (csops): great — marking this thread as the canonical coordination channel for the backfill. i'll update Confluence with the run timestamps and artifact links.

Ethan (dataops): closing loop: queued a nightly healthscore recompute for affected cohorts to avoid stale health signals. job id: nightly-recompute-171550.

Riley (enablement): thanks team — happy path established. follow-ups handled in Confluence + #cs-ops-bucket. :rocket:
